newsitem.title: USA: Mortgage-backed mart down, refinancing woes remain.
newsitem.headline: Mortgage-backed mart down, refinancing woes remain.

text.p: Mortgage-backed securities were mostly lower in quiet dealings late Thursday, participants said.
Market players reported seeing some mortgage banker sales as well as down-in-coupon activity as investors tried to dodge prepayment risk.
"There was little institutional presence this morning," said Sally Runyon, mortgage analyst at Technical Data.
Market players said continued increases in the Mortgage Bankers Association's weekly refinancing index come as no surprise, and the down-in-coupon moves were nothing new.
